patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kit and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Kit only if your buying job matches “Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations, and digi” rather than Mailjet's shape. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than Kit's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Kit is shaped for Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, a whereas Mailjet is shaped for EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending wit. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kit and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Kit is Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations, and digital product selling.; Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch)..
- Company-size focus: Kit (micro, small-business) vs Mailjet (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Kit — Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro; Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day).

Limitations — Kit: Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro; Paid pricing scales with subscribers; Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+.

Poor-fit cases: Kit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro · Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Avoid Kit if you actually need Mailjet's motion (EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-vol)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
